definitions.gloss: eager anticipation, looking forward to something
definitions.explanation: The feeling of eagerly and happily waiting for something to happen. Always positive — used when you are excited about something upcoming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{心待|こころま}ちにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm eagerly looking forward to spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{心待|こころま}ちにして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children were eagerly looking forward to Christmas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{来場|らいじょう}→来場：17703_raijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{心待|こころま}ちにして⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: We eagerly look forward to your attendance.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Almost exclusively used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {心待|こころま}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to look forward to). The polite form {心待|こころま}ちにして⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ is common in business correspondence and formal invitations.
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{心待|こころま}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to look forward to X
- {心待|こころま}ちにして⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧: we look forward to... (polite/business)
- {心待|こころま}ちにして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧: had been looking forward to

REGISTER:
While the word itself is somewhat literary, the polite form {心待|こころま}ちにして⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ is a standard business and formal expression.
